name: Purified Water
description: Water purity: drink clean water or get sick.

pages.title: Purified Water
pages.text:
Water has a **purity**: Dirty, Slightly Dirty, Acceptable, Purified. Dirty water always makes you sick and sometimes poisons you. Acceptable and Purified are safe.\
\
Boil to clean it: a campfire raises it one step per cook, a furnace takes Dirty straight to Acceptable. A Sand Filter purifies piped water.
